name: ambiguous-ai
description: The Ambiguous Workspace plugin — skill + CLI + MCP for human + AI teammates.

plugins.name: ambiguous
plugins.description: Ambiguous Workspace integration. Connects Claude Code to the workspace MCP server to read and change docs, sheets, slides, wiki pages, tasks, CRM records, calendar events, mail, chat and Drive files — the same REST surface the web app uses, so Claude acts with exactly the permissions your account already has. Signs in with OAuth; run claude mcp login ambiguous after installing.

plugins.name: ambiguous-agent
plugins.description: Ambiguous Workspace integration for a provisioned AI coworker. Same workspace surface as the ambiguous plugin — docs, sheets, slides, wiki pages, tasks, CRM records, calendar events, mail, chat and Drive files — but acts as the agent's own identity rather than as you, using its ak_ API key. Requires a key from Admin → People & Access → New agent; install fails without one.
